title: Canonical relative Proj map of a graded algebra morphism
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $A,B$ be quasi-coherent graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebras in the affine-basis presentation of [def-nagata-relative-proj]. Let $f:A\to B$ be a morphism in that category, so its graded algebra maps $f_V:A(V)\to B(V)$ on affine opens preserve base coefficients and commute with restriction. Define $\operatorname{IrrelevantLE}(f)$ to mean that for every affine open $V\subseteq X$, the irrelevant ideal $B(V)_+$ is contained in the ideal generated by $f_V(A(V)_+)$. Given $h:\operatorname{IrrelevantLE}(f)$, define the canonical contravariant morphism $\operatorname{relProjMap}(f,h):\operatorname{Proj}_X(B)\to\operatorname{Proj}_X(A)$ by gluing the local maps induced by $f_V$. For homogeneous $a\in A(V)_d$ with $d>0$, its local comorphism on the standard charts is the degree-zero homogeneous localization map $A(V)_{(a),0}\to B(V)_{(f_V(a)),0}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], sending $b/a^m$ to $f_V(b)/f_V(a)^m$. The irrelevant-ideal condition makes these source charts cover all of $\operatorname{Proj}(B(V))$. When every $f_V$ is surjective, use the canonical witness $\operatorname{irrelevantLE\_of\_surjective}(f)$ for this condition: each homogeneous positive-degree target element has a preimage of the same degree. This witness is the one used to form the quotient-induced relative Proj map. No equality $A_0=\mathcal O_X$ or $B_0=\mathcal O_X$ is required.

source.place: Tag 01MY (lemma-morphism-proj), its canonical chart maps when the irrelevant-ideal condition makes the domain all of Proj(B); Tag 01MZ (lemma-morphism-proj-transitive) and Tag 01NQ (lemma-glue-relative-proj) for compatibility and relative gluing. Construction used in step 5 of lem-sfb-polynomial-quotient-proj-cartesian.
